title: WHEN YOUR SOUL
FEELS HEAVY
end: The Praise Garden — enter His gates with thanksgiving
stock_queries: misty forest glade morning soft sunbeams
calm mountain lake glowing dawn light
golden sunlight through tall forest trees
peaceful river flowing through green meadow
soft golden sun setting over countryside
gentle stream shining in afternoon sun

scenes.a: Your soul feels heavy in the silence.
scenes.sub: IN THE STILLNESS OF THIS HOUR

scenes.a: Hear the quiet truth of Psalm 42:11:
Why art thou cast down, O my soul? and why art thou disquieted within me? hope thou in God: for I shall yet praise him, who is the health of my countenance, and my God.
Lord, when disquiet stirs inside us today, we thank You that our hope is never anchored in our feelings.
You are the restoration of our countenance, turning our downward gaze back to Your faithful presence.
We praise You now, trusting You with every quiet sorrow.
Amen. Rest easy when your soul feels heavy.
